meta.purpose: Real-NBA reference values for game-FLOW metrics (harness/src/flow.ts) and event-grammar magnitudes, with distributions. Every value carries provenance and is regenerated by tools/parse-nba.mjs from the committed pbp corpus — never hand-typed.

primarySample.what: 184 2025-26 regular-season games parsed from public basketball-reference play-by-play pages, spread over 21 dates across the season (composition in data/nba/pbp-corpus.json meta.dates); metrics computed with the operational definitions flow.ts applies to sim events (meta.definitions below).
primarySample.validation: 184/184 games pass the three-way score validation (play-stream points == text-derived points == scorebox final)
primarySample.caveat: Grading scheme (extended at the corpus milestone, provenance-first as before): grade A = published multi-season data with methodology OR computed from this validated n>=100 primary corpus with a stated definition; grade B = computed from primary play-by-play at small n or with a thin definition; grade C = derived/provisional. Distributions are per-game unless the dist.unit says otherwise; value is the per-game mean unless the basis says pooled.

previousAnchor.note: The retired n=6 anchor this corpus replaces (kept for scholarship; deltas in meta.changesVsAnchor).

definitions.leadChange: scoreboard leader flips sign between two scoring events; tie interludes are not changes; a tie is counted once when entered from a led state
definitions.run: maximal consecutive unanswered points (an 8-0 inside a 12-0 counts once); OT included
definitions.drought: one team's longest gap between its own scoring events on the game clock, regulation only, tip and final horn as endpoints
definitions.clutch: Q4, game clock <= 2:00, margin within 5 BEFORE the scoring event; clutchFTShare = FT points / all points inside the window, averaged per qualifying game
definitions.q4Comeback: a side's margin reaches >= 10 at a scoring event in Q4 and that side loses the game (mirrors flow.ts: evaluated at scoring events, so a 10+ lead carried into Q4 registers at the first Q4 scoring event that keeps it >= 10)
definitions.possession: boundaries = made FG (and-1 trips end at the made final FT), defensive rebound (player or team), turnover, made final FT of a plain N-of-N trip, period end; length = game-clock seconds between boundaries (FT sequences freeze the clock); technical/flagrant/clear-path FTs do not end possessions
definitions.putback: any FGA by the rebounding team within 6s (game clock) of a PLAYER offensive rebound; forward scan stops at the next rebound/turnover
definitions.stealToScore: made FG (FTs excluded) by the stealing team within 6s of the steal; scan stops at rebound/turnover
definitions.andOne: made FG with a shooting-foul row within 1s of the same game clock
ambiguitiesResolved: OREB denominator: bbref logs "Offensive rebound by Team" bookkeeping rows (mostly dead-ball after missed non-final FTs) — excluded from the putback denominator and from second-chance marking; the sim has no team-rebound events so player rebounds are the comparable base. Anchor-definition values are preserved in dist.legacyAnchorDefinition.

putback numerator: meta scholarship says "any next shot" and flow.ts counts any FGA, but the anchor implementation counted only 2-pt layup/dunk/hook/jump and also stopped at fouls — corpus uses any-FGA/stop-at-rebound-or-turnover to mirror flow.ts.
steal conversion: anchor implementation counted any "makes" by either side including FTs; corpus requires a made FG by the stealing side (mirrors flow.ts).
drought: anchor implementation let OT scoring events extend droughts in OT games despite the regulation-only definition; corpus enforces regulation-only strictly.

possession segmentation cannot see mid-game jump-ball flips or away-from-play FT retentions (both rare); flagrant/clear-path FT phrasings never match the plain N-of-N boundary regex, so those trips correctly do not end possessions.
secondChanceShareOfPoss denominator is ALL possessions (both teams pooled); flow.ts currently divides by poss/2 — reconcile on the sim side before gating.

publishedSources.note: Published/derived values from a sourced research pass (2026-07-27); where they disagree with the primary sample the DEFINITION usually differs — flow.ts implements the strict definitions documented here.
publishedSources.leadChanges: NBA stats survey via AP (2023-24): 26.7/game — but that is a RECORD year under a looser definition (counts every flip incl. within FT sequences); strict scoring-event flips (ours) run far lower. Grade B.
publishedSources.runs: FortyEightEightyTwo blog: ~77% of games contain a 10-0+ run; 16% contain a 15-0+ (season unstated, grade B). Academic: Bozhidarova et al. arXiv 2606.27957 (2019-25, 7054 games) — unanswered runs skew to 2-6 pts, grade A (qualitative).
publishedSources.comebacks: PlayNY (14-yr): down 10 after Q3 wins 12.9% home / 11.1% road (grade B). inpredictable is canonical for WP methodology (grade A) but publishes no static up-10-Q4 table.
publishedSources.possessionLength: inpredictable: mean 14.67s/possession (2017-18, PRE the 2018 OREB 14s-reset rule — era boundary; grade A). NBA/Second Spectrum buckets its shot-clock data 24-22/22-18/18-15/15-7/7-4/4-0 — not the 0-7/7-15/15-24 scheme anyone assumes (grade A).
publishedSources.clutch: Definitional chaos across sources (last-5min/margin-5 vs last-2min/margin-3). Clutch PPP runs HIGHER than season avg via intentional-foul FTs despite lower FG% (82games, grade B). Our clutchFTShare stays grade C until self-computed at scale.
publishedSources.quarterProfile: No authoritative league table found; one unverified source suggests Q4 is the HIGHEST-scoring quarter (FT parade), contradicting our 6-game Q4-lowest sample — treat quarter profile as unvalidated either way (grade C).
publishedSources.grammar: Putback: CTG standard is 3s-after-OREB halfcourt-only (ours is 6s incl. any next shot — hence our 33% vs their narrower base). Second-chance points: 11.7-17.6 per team-game (2024-25, grade B). And-one per-game: no in-era league figure exists; our 4.8 primary stands (grade B).

turingBaseline.protocol: 30 blind excerpts (15 sim / 15 real bbref, same dry register, pseudonymized, Q2-Q3 windows, 14 plays), 5 independent LLM judges, forced choice
turingBaseline.discriminationAccuracy: 15/30 = 50% (95% CI 32-68%) — coin-flip; sim passed as REAL 11/15 (73%), judge false-alarm rate on real 4/15 (27%)
simTells: repeated identical shot distances (26ft threes / 4-5ft twos) from fixed spacing spots
shot-type monotony: sub-8ft attempts all read 'jump shot' (no layup/floater/hook vocabulary)
missing real-game event vocabulary: timeouts, replay reviews, team rebounds all read as REAL markers to judges
protocolFixes: unicode pseudonymizer bug mangled diacritic names on the REAL side (fixed in turing.ts)
renderer lacks bbref's 'at rim' phrasing variant

leadChangesPerGame.basis: corpus n=184 (2025-26), strict scoring-event leader flips (ties excluded; a tie counted once on entry). Published looser definitions (every flip inside FT sequences) run far higher — see meta.publishedSources.

tiesPerGame.basis: corpus n=184: scoring events that produce a tie from a led state

largestLeadPerGame.basis: corpus n=184: max absolute margin at any scoring event (OT included)

maxRunPerGame.basis: corpus n=184: largest maximal unanswered run per game

maxTeamDroughtSec.basis: corpus n=184: one team's longest gap between own scores, regulation only, tip/horn endpoints

quarterPtsProfile.basis: corpus n=184, both teams combined, regulation quarters

clutchFTShare.basis: corpus: 63 of 184 games had scoring inside the window (Q4, clock<=2:00, margin<=5 before the event). value = mean of per-game FT-point shares (matches flow.ts aggregation); pooled points ratio = 0.354. The foul-game spike concentrates in the final ~40s.

dist.unit: share of games with a 10+ Q4 lead

q4Lead10LostRate.basis: corpus: 8 of 148 games where a side's margin reached >= 10 at a Q4 scoring event ended with that side losing (range = Wilson 95% CI). Direct computation replaces the derived win-probability estimate.

possessionP50Sec.basis: corpus: 36703 possessions segmented from pbp (boundaries: made FG with and-1 trips ending at the final FT, defensive rebound, turnover, made final FT, period end). Mean 14.47s cross-checks published ~14.7s (inpredictable 2017-18, pre-OREB-reset era). Possessions/game: mean 199.5.

dist.unit: share of pooled possessions with length <= 8s

possessionShare0to8.basis: corpus, same segmentation as possessionP50Sec — reference for flow.ts's possShare0to8 report line (previously unreferenced)

dist.unit: share of pooled possessions with length >= 16s

possessionShare16plus.basis: corpus, same segmentation — reference for flow.ts's possShare16plus report line (previously unreferenced)

putbackWithin6sShareOfOreb.basis: corpus: 2974 putback FGAs within 6s of 4151 PLAYER offensive rebounds (any next FGA by the rebounding team, scan stops at rebound/turnover — mirrors flow.ts). DEFINITION FIX vs the n=6 anchor: the anchor divided by ALL OREB rows including 2373 team-rebound bookkeeping rows (mostly dead-ball missed-FT artifacts) and counted only 2-pt attempts; that legacy definition yields 0.348 on this corpus (anchor said 0.33). CTG's ~3s halfcourt-only standard is narrower still — see meta.publishedSources.grammar.

stealToScoreWithin6sShare.basis: corpus: 925 of 3157 steals converted to a made FG by the stealing team within 6s (mirrors flow.ts: FTs excluded, scan stops at rebound/turnover). DEFINITION FIX vs the n=6 anchor implementation, which counted any 'makes' by either side incl. FTs; that legacy definition yields 0.292 on this corpus (anchor said 0.29).

andOnesPerGame.basis: corpus n=184, both teams: made FG with a shooting-foul row within 1s of game clock

secondChanceShareOfPoss.basis: corpus: share of ALL possessions (both teams pooled) containing >= 1 live offensive rebound (team-rebound rows directly after missed non-final FTs excluded as dead-ball bookkeeping). NOTE for flow.ts: its report divides both-team second-chance possessions by poss/2 (a per-team denominator), which reads ~2x this definition — reconcile before gating.
